surface_note: Kiwi.join restores form/POS tokens; it can normalize contractions and spaces.

membership_scope.token_rule: Exact aligned contiguous ID sequence within actual train paragraph content; edge WS ignored. No BOS/EOS or cross-paragraph matches.
membership_scope.surface_rule: Whitespace-normalized full query occurs inside a source sentence; candidate must be train-split, in-vocabulary, and its original numeric token line must occur in actual train IDs.
membership_scope.limitations: No exact match does not prove absence of memorization or semantic copying. Samples are not a held-out quality benchmark; no rejection sampling.
